# Sun: lineage net change: tables (generated by lin_fit.py)

lineage net = (start contacts lost + lineage contacts made) / cells at the start; D = rms centroid displacement of survivors (spacings, the parent's); step 10 s unless stated. Null = moving Poisson-Voronoi with births and deaths at the setting's census rates, matched D(tau) (main); V1 matched survival; V2 split births. "no births" = the parent's null curve.
